title: National Assembly Examines Professional Sport Reform Bill with Major Football Implications
detail: The National Assembly has begun examining a bill reforming professional sport in France, with potentially sweeping implications for French football. The legislation addresses the governance and financial structure of professional clubs, representing one of the most significant regulatory overhauls of French sport in years.

title: Government Spokesperson Bregeon Backs Edouard Philippe for 2027 Presidential Race
detail: Government spokesperson Maud Bregeon announced her support for former Prime Minister Edouard Philippe ahead of the 2027 presidential election, adding centrist momentum to his candidacy. The endorsement signals growing centrist consolidation around Philippe as a leading contender in the upcoming election cycle.
